MP CM Mohan Yadav Secures Investment Proposals in Mumbai

Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav met with industrialists in Mumbai, securing investment proposals worth ₹90,000 crore. These investments are expected to create over 14,000 jobs for the state's youth. The Chief Minister also reportedly sought the death penalty for those convicted in the Surajpur incident.
